rules.digests: SHA256 of ordered fact3 list sort_keys/minified/ensure_ascii=False UTF8 canonical JSON plus LF.
rules.graph_id: SHA256 of sort_keys/minified/ensure_ascii=False UTF8 canonical JSON plus LF for {snapshot,role,record_set_LF_fact3_sha256}.
rules.header_constraint: Future qualified Source must enforce canonical header bytes<=65536,nodes<=4096,complete tree depth<=48 andnodes<=50000; this metadata arithmetic is not an implemented guard.
rules.no_materialization: No raw bodies read or generated, no Base64 bodies materialized, no originalvirtual-path writes, no per-record files.
rules.node_upper_bound: 4096 + 15*row_count; dict keys and values count as nodes; header includes empty records list.
rules.output_upper_bound: 65536 + sum(ensure_ascii=True canonical empty-row bytes without LF + 4*((pin.bytes+2)//3)) + max(row_count-1,0); header with records=[] includes LF.
rules.physical_copy_cap: A later explicitly approved inert bundle+manifest publication must prove<=512 totalcopyrows and<=64MiB; this plan grants no publication.
rules.raw_roster: Exact six saved graph namespaces; same path or bytes across graphs are not deduplicated or rebound.
rules.selection: Greedy contiguous original one-based whole-record ordinals; start new partition before raw sum would exceed1048576.
